House Bill 219 (AS PASSED HOUSE AND SENATE) By: Representatives Stephens of the 164th, Davis of the 87th, and Clark of the 100th
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to professions and businesses, … grants, in-kind gifts, or any other funding or donations that may be available to facilitate the purpose of conducting a professional health program."
SECTION 3. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
